packet_export.ref_policy: Use the full main SHA produced by merging this release; external immutable directories only.

platform_creation_conditions.codex: record exact configured model and isolation before scientific input
platform_creation_conditions.deepseek: record observed DeepSeek model and isolation; challenger packet waits for frozen proposal
platform_creation_conditions.claude: record exact host-exposed Claude model and isolation; abort if no Claude-family model is exposed

notes: This record authorizes role creation only after independent review and merge.
Historical sessions and PR #4 are excluded from scientific inputs.
Actual session IDs, model IDs, packet hashes and isolation attestations are recorded only after sessions are created.
